Just like there was no confirmation screen previous about setting up your OTP there is no confirmation screen when you setup your security key. That certainly needs to be changed and it should even have you test it after adding it to make sure it functions correctly.

I think there should be a message that says "Should you use X2F to procure (or buy or purchse, whichever) then what wallet address should those funds be transferred to. In smaller writing "In the case that you wish to use a different XMR address for each transaction any buyer/seller that setup their account with secure security will be asked to use the default address or enter a new one for the trade they are starting. If your account is rated anything less then secure you will have to wait 24 hours before the new wallet address becomes into effect and is added in settings. - we need to make our system capable of determining if their accounts are weak (using only display name, login name, and password) or secure using those 3 things and a minimum of one of the other posssibities. If they are weak they will not get the option of adding a new wallet  on the screen the pops up after the click to enter a trade with someone. The screen where they enter the amount and everything. They will see the drop down and any approved address will be selectable. For anyone that is rated secure they will have the option of selecting from the drop down but also adding a new wallet right then and there which they can choose for it to be a one-time use or saved for future trades. The people with weak accounts will have to add new wallets in settings and they can also choose one-time or saved for future and both users should also be able to give the wallet a name so it means something to them that they will rememner without having to remmeber the whoke wallet address.

Here we arent really doing anything by letting them click different monero wallets. This should be more of a recommendation of well known monero wallets available today. If there are more we can list those too and say and many more. Please use your favourite and enter in an address from that wallet. - also inside the edge wallet i dont see anythung about what we are recommending them to do so maybe confirm that

This screen should tell them what their security rating is rated but also always add Username/Password as a bullet point but also give them the option of going back to that particular setting and chnaging it in case they want to go back and make it more secure
